name: A flowchart lays out from its flow and a flow opens in the reading that fits
summary: The flowchart lays a flow out from its structure in one pass, breaks a long run into columns and ends every long line at a lettered jump, so a long flow fits a desktop pane without lines round its blocks, and a flow opens in the reading that its pane shows larger.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/gbyqW4H3#0idmUHd2
changes.value: Lays out one flow's logic from its structure: steps on one axis, answers side by side, long lines and column breaks as lettered jumps

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/gbyqW4H3#0idmUHd2
changes.value: A flow is a run of blocks: a box, a decision, a guard, a landing or a loop. The layout stacks a run on one axis, with steps that follow each other close and no line between them, and stands the answers of a decision side by side, the taller of two straight on down. A line that would run far round other blocks jumps: it stops at a jump out and goes on at the jump in of the same letter and ink. The short answer of a guard jumps to the landing where its long answer ends, a long loop jumps back to its hexagon and on from beside it, and a run that is taller than its column height breaks into even columns that jump from one to the next. The core keeps the column height at which the reference pane shows the picture largest, and letters the jumps in the order the picture holds them (ADR 0073). No layout engine takes part, so the lines cross nowhere.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#n2ONtqdt
changes.value:
Reads current, draft, completed, and exact architecture with explicit unavailable states. One catalogue supplies reading and comparison choices. Recursive scopes expose complete interfaces and relationship evidence. The router owns scope, state, checkpoint, focus, filters, grammar, flow, comparison, and foreign destinations.

Selection retains canonical identities through renames, hidden subjects, and removed comparison definitions. Pointer modifiers, keyboard commands, and area selection share one owner. Focus opens containment paths. Filters preserve complete interfaces. Behavioral readings retain all participants and steps. A flow opens in the reading that its pane shows larger, and a tie opens the sequence.

Code and foreign navigation preserve exact historical pins. State details expose decisions, dates, documents, correction audit, unresolved issues, and blocked ancestry. Explanation actions capture the exact reading through the existing local action.

Each reader belongs to its resolved vault. Captured walkthroughs reuse its renderer and camera, retain the ordinary reading, and change revision only on explicit restart. Every converted beat requires an explicit view. Unavailable beats draw no replacement architecture.

Migration previews retain original coverage, lifecycle, standing, predecessors, and baselines. Failed composition keeps exact originals inspectable without claiming an empty current model. The browser authors no mapping, settlement, lifecycle decision, or migration.

Installed bookmarks preserve canonical authority and exact view membership without owning model content. Former addresses reopen retained originals with their exact state and checkpoint. Model ownership transfer remains explicitly unavailable.
